name: Transaction-count surge confirms a 20-day breakout — btc_tx_count cross-up on a high-RSI BTC/ETH long
rationale: Thesis: a breakout (price strength shown by elevated RSI) is more durable when on-chain throughput is simultaneously accelerating — real economic activity, not just a thin price push. btc_tx_count drifts with network growth, so it is used ONLY as a cross_up (a fresh surge in daily transactions). RSI is BOUNDED [0-100] and a fitted floor genuinely binds, so RSI>rsi_floor is our breakout/strength proxy. Disconfirmer 1: drop the tx_count cross_up and keep only RSI>rsi_floor — if the deflated Sharpe holds, the on-chain term is redundant and we are merely buying price strength. Disconfirmer 2: tx_count can spike from dust/spam or fee-market quirks unrelated to demand; a permuted-timing ablation (random lag on the on-chain series) must DESTROY the edge, else the cross timing carries no information. Long-only spot, BTC and ETH only (the two assets whose own-chain tx_count is the cleanest read of the broader crypto risk cycle).
catalyst: btc_tx_count crosses up through its surge threshold while RSI confirms a breakout
